title: Online design of dynamic networks
abstract: arXiv:2410.08875v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing a network (e.g., a telecommunication or transport network) is mainly done offline, in a planning phase, prior to the operation of the network. On the other hand, a massive effort has been devoted to characterizing dynamic networks, i.e., those that evolve over time. The novelty of this paper is that we introduce a method for the online design of dynamic networks. The need to do so emerges when a network needs to operate in a dynamic and stochastic environment. In this case, one may wish to build a network over time, on the fly, in order to react to the changes of the environment and to keep certain performance targets. We tackle this online design problem with a rolling horizon optimization based on Monte Carlo Tree Search. The potential of online network design is showcased for the design of a futuristic dynamic public transport network, where bus lines are constructed on the fly to better adapt to a stochastic user demand

translated_abstract: arXiv:2410.08875v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：设计网络（例如电信或交通网络）主要在离线状态下进行，即在网络运行前的规划阶段完成。另一方面，大量研究致力于表征动态网络，即随时间演化的网络。本文的新颖之处在于，我们引入了一种动态网络的在线设计方法。这种需求在网络需要在动态和随机环境中运行时出现。在这种情况下，人们可能希望随时间即时构建网络，以响应环境变化并保持某些性能目标。我们通过基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的滚动时域优化来解决这一在线设计问题。在线网络设计的潜力通过设计一个未来动态公共交通网络得以展示，其中公交线路即时构建以更好地适应随机用户需求。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的滚动时域优化方法，用于动态网络的在线设计，并通过动态公共交通网络的案例展示了其适应随机需求的潜力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an online design method for dynamic networks using rolling horizon optimization based on Monte Carlo Tree Search, demonstrated on a futuristic public transport network adapting to stochastic demand.
